accounts.title: Accounts and access
accounts.body: Sign-in is provided by MindAuth. Keep your account secure and do not use another person’s account without permission. We may restrict access when needed to protect the community or service.

content.title: Your content
content.body: You keep ownership of content you create. You grant Mindustry Club permission to host, display, distribute, and make that content available as needed to operate the service. You may remove your content where the service provides that option, subject to legal, security, and backup needs.

conduct.title: Community conduct
conduct.body: Do not harass people, impersonate others, spam, interfere with the service, or upload malicious files. Follow the Community Guidelines and Content & Resource Rules.

moderation.title: Moderation and availability
moderation.body: Members may report content. Administrators may hide or remove content and restrict accounts to address safety, rights, or abuse reports. Mindustry Club is an independent player community, is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anuken or the official Mindustry project, and may change or be unavailable.

identity.title: Account data
identity.body: MindAuth provides account identity. Mindustry Club stores its own profile, posts, replies, resource records, and moderation decisions in an independent community database.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: We process account details, email verification state, IP address and request metadata, session cookies, and security or moderation logs to provide the service, prevent abuse, and investigate reports. Access to IP and security logs is restricted, and they are kept only as needed.

cookies.title: Cookies and language
cookies.body: Essential cookies keep sessions secure and remember your language and feed preferences. We do not use them for cross-site advertising.

publicContent.title: Public content
publicContent.body: Public posts and resource pages may be visible to anyone, including search engines.

requests.title: Privacy requests
requests.body: Contact the site administrators through the report or feedback tools for privacy questions or account deletion requests.

respect.title: Be considerate
respect.body: Critique ideas without targeting people. Do not harass, threaten, or impersonate other members.

discussion.title: Keep discussions useful
discussion.body: Keep discussions on topic, share context, and avoid spam, scams, and disruptive behavior.

credit.title: Credit creators
credit.body: Credit creators and link to original sources when possible. Respect licenses and attribution requests.

safety.title: Protect the community
safety.body: Do not publish personal information, malicious links, or content intended to compromise devices or accounts.

reporting.title: Report concerns
reporting.body: Use the report action when content needs administrator attention. Do not use reports to target or silence other members.

rights.title: Share responsibly
rights.body: Upload only material you have the right to share. Include the applicable license and credit original authors.

metadata.title: Describe resources accurately
metadata.body: Describe versions and compatibility accurately. Do not misrepresent authorship, files, or how a resource works.

prohibited.title: Unsafe files
prohibited.body: Do not upload malware, trojans, backdoors, credential theft tools, or files intended to damage devices or accounts.

review.title: Review
review.body: Resource submissions may be checked for abuse and unsafe content. Administrators may restrict material while reviewing a report.

submit.title: Submit a request
submit.body: If you believe content on Mindustry Club infringes your rights, send the site administrators the page or resource URL, identify the material and the right you hold, explain what action you request, and include a way to contact you.

review.title: Review and action
review.body: Administrators review reports, may temporarily restrict disputed material, and may remove content or restore access after review.

abuse.title: Abusive reports
abuse.body: False or abusive reports may be rejected. Provide accurate information and only submit requests in good faith.
